'''Patrol barges''' were [[Starship/Legends|starships]] used by [[Navy/Legends|navies]] to patrol various areas of space. Some were in service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
